name: server-search
description: Two horizontal server bays beside a magnifying glass.
useCase: Find a server or locate a host in an infrastructure inventory.
misuse: Use a label when the control filters a host list or inspects a server.

16.reason: The broad upper bay keeps its indicator and vent, while the lower rim opens around the complete magnifying glass.

24.reason: The wider bays retain their server profile and clear spacing around the complete magnifying glass.
